key_findings: Neuron-derived NLRP3 inflammasome is activated in spinal dorsal horn of cyclophosphamide IC rats and drives glial activation, cytokines and allodynia (MCC950 reverses).
Intrathecal MSC-EVs relieve allodynia and neuroinflammation, inhibiting NLRP3 and TLR4/NF-kB.
